item.title: Home | LearningHUB
item.description:
The PSA Corporate Learning Branch and its partners offer hundreds of courses, available to all BCPS employees. The LearningHUB is the place to see that full catalogue of corporate offerings.

Context: The site itself. Runs on WordPress, which is on OpenShift but is not under our control. Not sure who actually controls it these days. itservicerequest@gov.bc.ca for support.

Step Objective: The PSA Corporate Learning Branch and its partners offer hundreds of courses, available to all BCPS employees. The LearningHUB is the place to see that full catalogue of corporate offerings.

item.title: PSA-Corporate-Learning-Branch/lsapp: LSApp (Learning Support Admin Application)
item.description:
LSApp (Learning Support Admin Application) acts as middleware between the many different learning systems that CLB deals with. - PSA-Corporate-Learning-Branch/lsapp

Context: The primary repository for the code.

Step Objective: Learning Support Administration Application is the "middleware" of Corporate Learning. It contains the canonical list of corporate learning courses and a growing list of the associated metadata that supports delivery and maintenance of the catalogue. From partnership information to class sizes and enrolment info, LSApp has answers to many of your questions.

item.title: bcgov
item.description:
This is the home for code that is open. bcgov has 2435 repositories available. Follow their code on GitHub.

Context: The primary BCGOV organization on GitHub. You need to be a member here if you want to make contributions to our open source projects that reside on OpenShift.

Step Objective: GitHub is owned by Microsoft and is tightly integrated into everything we do. While that is the case, GitHub doesn't have Single-Sign On with your BC Gov account. You'll need to create a GitHub account and ensure it has Multi-Factor Authentication turned on in order to join to requisite organizations to make contributions.
